title: Intermittent resolution failures across every service
root_cause_summary: One of the two cluster DNS pods was serving SERVFAIL, so roughly half of all resolutions failed regardless of which service or peer was involved.

required_evidence.why: resolution latency stepping up at onset
three unrelated services failing at once points below the application layer

red_herrings.why_tempting: a DNS change in the window, but 28 minutes after onset and a mitigation
